dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Thanks be to the Anemo Archon...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you up to?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I'm praying to Lord Barbatos. It was by his protection that Mondstadt was able to weather this storm.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: We also have him to thank for the safety of the Knights of Favonius and the adventurers of the Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Thank you, Lord Barbatos...

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: I dare not fathom the things Lord Barbatos has done for us.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: But just knowing that such a diligent deity watches over Mondstadt sets my heart at ease.

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: Ah, yes. If you have some time, could you do me a favor?

response.speaker: Grace
response.text: I'd like you to help me collect one batch of Dandelion Seeds, and scatter them to the winds at the top of the Anemo Archon Statue...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I've heard of this one...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Oh, but didn't you help Glory scatter Dandelion Seeds in the same manner before? Did you forget?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why is this done?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Dandelion Seeds that go with the wind carry the feelings in our hearts with them, whether that feeling is remembrance, or thanksgiving.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Lord Barbatos is the Anemo Archon, so it is most fitting to use these Dandelion Seeds to express our thanks to him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Allow me, then.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are Dandelion Seeds all you need?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Yes, they will suffice. The other flowers in Mondstadt do not scatter in to the distance very well, in any case.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: So please do help me get a batch of Dandelion Seeds. I will wait here for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About those unsettling omens I keep seeing...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: No matter what the cause may be, all we can do is pray.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I had some adventurers help me collect some Cecilia buds to give everyone...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: These flowers grow on top of cliffs, whisked by the Mondstadt winds...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Perhaps these flowers that emanate the essence of Barbatos can bring some peace of mind to everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Here, please take some. May Barbatos shine upon Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: If you wish to pray to Barbatos, you can do it here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Barbatos.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Barbatos is a very gentle archon.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: His wind grants happiness to the people of the city and wipes the tears off of their faces.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about praying to Barbatos.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: If you wish to pray to Barbatos, just speak your wishes when there's a breeze...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: It will carry your wish to Barbatos.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Recently, there's uneasiness in the air. So I'm praying to Barbatos.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Be at ease. Barbatos will help us.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: May Barbatos' gentle wind be with you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I fear that this is one of the causes for the unease in everyone's hearts...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: I am not a Knight of Favonius, and so, I can only pray to the winds.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Oh, Lord Barbatos, defend the people of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Lord Barbatos has indeed heard our prayers. Mondstadt is safe once again.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Although I say that it is over, Dvalin's influence will likely remain for a while longer...

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: But I believe that as long as the winds of Mondstadt persist, Lord Barbatos will always be with us.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps he is already amongst us. Who can say?
